duration.text: The Observation and Control Technique and Instruments at Qingdao Technological University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2361 USD/per year ￥ 17000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 4.Resume Written in Chinese or in English 5.High school academic transcript 6.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 7.Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months)

requirements.text: 1.Applicants should be 17 years old and above 2.HSK level 3 or above 3.Senior high school graduate or equivalent 4.Pass the entry exam. 5.Be in good health condition
